tradeoff_explanation: top-3 title hit rate: all strategies tie at 1.000. MRR: all strategies tie at 1.000. answer-point recall in the top 3: all strategies tie at 1.000. sentence_window gives the smallest chunks (8 chunks, avg 179 chars): tighter citations, less context per chunk. paragraph gives the largest (4 chunks, avg 358 chars): more context, coarser citations and more unrelated text competing in each chunk. Primary strategy for this run: sentence_window.
caveat: Measured on 4 documents and 5 queries. At this size differences are anecdotal, and title-level hit rate cannot separate strategies when each document fits in a handful of chunks; treat MRR and answer-point recall as tie-breakers only.
